capabilities: Obfuscate marked text as runic characters
Reveal selected letters or words within obfuscated text
Prerender obfuscated text as runic characters in exported HTML
disambiguation: Not a text encryption or redaction tool; the README warns the obfuscated text is not truly private and is vulnerable to dictionary or pattern matching.
extras: The README warns the obfuscation is not secure: the text structure survives in exported HTML, so it is prone to dictionary or pattern matching attacks and should not be used for truly sensitive content.
motivation: The author built it primarily to work with Obsidian Webpage Export, and that integration drove the design decisions.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to mark text so it appears obfuscated in the editor and in exported pages.

relations.evidence: This plugin was made to be used in conjunction with Obsidian Webpage Export

summary: Markdown syntax plugin that renders text between ~ markers as animated runic characters, with some characters optionally left readable.
